items.source: expression - a space-separated list of time fields, following cron expression conventions
items.translation: expression - 遵循 cron 表达式约定的空格分隔时间字段列表。

items.source: Note that such explicit time zone customization is usually not necessary, using TaskScheduler.getClock() instead.
items.translation: 请注意，通常不需要进行这种显式的时间区域自定义，而是可以使用TaskScheduler.getClock()。

items.source:
This variant does not make up for missed trigger firings if the
associated task has taken too long. As a consequence, original trigger
firings may be skipped if the previous task is still running.
items.translation: 如果关联任务耗时过长，此变体无法弥补错过的触发器执行。因此，如果前一个任务仍在运行，可能会跳过原始的触发器执行。

items.source:
This variant makes up for missed trigger firings if the associated task
has taken too long, scheduling a task for every original trigger firing.
Such follow-up tasks may execute late but will never be skipped.
items.translation: 此变体通过为每个原始触发器执行安排任务，来弥补因关联任务耗时过长而错过的触发器执行。此类后续任务可能会延迟执行，但绝不会跳过。

items.source: Build a CronTrigger from the pattern provided in the given time zone, with the same lenient execution as CronTrigger(String).
items.translation: 根据给定时间区中的模式构建一个 `CronTrigger`，其宽松执行方式与 `CronTrigger(String)` 相同。

items.source: Create a CronTrigger for fixed execution, to be rescheduled after every task based on the last scheduled time.
items.translation: 创建用于固定执行的CronTrigger，以便根据上次调度时间在每个任务后重新调度。

items.source: Create a CronTrigger for lenient execution, to be rescheduled after every task based on the completion time.
items.translation: 创建用于宽松执行的CronTrigger，以便根据任务的完成时间重新调度。

items.source: This is equivalent to the forLenientExecution(String) factory method. Original trigger firings may be skipped if the previous task is still running; if this is not desirable, consider forFixedExecution(String).
items.translation: 这与forLenientExecution(String)工厂方法等效。如果前一个任务仍在运行，可能会跳过原始触发器的执行；如果不希望这样，请考虑使用forFixedExecution(String)。

items.source: This is equivalent to the regular CronTrigger constructor. Note that lenient execution is scheduler-dependent: it may skip trigger firings with long-running tasks on a thread pool while executing at forFixedExecution(String)-like precision with new threads per task.
items.translation: 这与常规的 CronTrigger 构造函数等效。请注意，宽松执行取决于调度器：在线程池中，它可能会跳过具有长时间运行任务的触发器执行，但会以类似于 forFixedExecution(String) 的精度为每个任务使用新线程进行执行。

items.source: Next execution times are calculated based on the completion time of the previous execution; therefore, overlapping executions won't occur.
items.translation: 下一次执行时间是根据上一次执行的完成时间计算的；因此，不会出现重叠的执行。

items.source:
Immediate versus late execution in case of long-running tasks may
be scheduler-dependent but the guarantee to never skip a task is portable.
items.translation: 对于长时间运行的任务，立即执行与延迟执行可能取决于调度器，但从不跳过任务的保证是可移植的。

items.source: Return the cron pattern that this trigger has been built with.
items.translation: 返回该触发器所基于的 Cron 模式。

items.translation: zoneId - 将在此时区中生成触发时间

items.source: resumptionTimestamp - the timestamp to resume from (the last-known completion timestamp), with the new trigger calculated from there and possibly immediately firing (but only once, every subsequent calculation will start from the completion time of that first resumed trigger)
items.translation: resumptionTimestamp - 用于从中恢复的时间戳（即最后已知的完成时间戳），新的触发器将从该时间戳计算得出，并可能立即触发（但仅触发一次；此后每次计算均从第一次恢复的触发器的完成时间开始）。

items.source: resumptionTimestamp - the timestamp to resume from (the last-known scheduled timestamp), with every trigger in-between immediately firing to make up for every execution that would have happened in the meantime
items.translation: resumptionTimestamp - 恢复时间戳（即最后已知的调度时间戳），在此期间的每个触发器都会立即执行，以弥补在此期间本应发生的所有执行。

items.source:
Supports a Quartz day-of-month/week field with an L/# expression. Follows
common cron conventions in every other respect, including 0-6 for SUN-SAT
(plus 7 for SUN as well). Note that Quartz deviates from the day-of-week
convention in cron through 1-7 for SUN-SAT whereas Spring strictly follows
cron even in combination with the optional Quartz-specific L/# expressions.
items.translation: 支持带有 L/# 表达式的 Quartz 日/周字段。除遵循常见的 cron 约定外（包括 0-6 表示周日到周六，外加 7 也表示周日），请注意 Quartz 在日/周字段的约定上与 cron 不同，采用 1-7 表示周日到周六；而 Spring 即使在结合可选的 Quartz 专用 L/# 表达式时，也严格遵循 cron 约定。
